name: Pembrolizumab Monotherapy (anti-PD-1)
cyclesNote: flat-dose anti-PD-1 continued until disease progression or unacceptable toxicity; alternate schedule 400 mg every 42 days

institution.provenance: ONCQIS grounded Standard Protocol (experimental, owner/device test only; not clinically activated)

supportiveCare: Immune-related adverse event surveillance (thyroid, hepatic, pulmonary, colitis, dermatologic, endocrine).
Antiemetic prophylaxis not routinely required for single-agent checkpoint inhibitor (minimal emetic risk).
monitoring: immune-related toxicity screen (TSH/free T4, LFTs, glucose, cortisol as indicated) during therapy

doseModificationRules.condition: grade 2 or higher immune-related adverse event
doseModificationRules.text: Hold pembrolizumab and manage with corticosteroids per immune-related adverse event guidance; obtain clinical review before rechallenge.

drugs.name: Pembrolizumab
drugs.notes: Pembrolizumab 200 mg IV flat dose on day 1 every 21 days; alternate schedule 400 mg IV every 42 days. Flat milligram dosing (not weight-based). Used for biomarker-selected (dMMR/MSI-high, TMB-high) or PD-L1-positive recurrent/metastatic cervical cancer, or as part of biomarker-directed later-line therapy. Continue until progression or unacceptable toxicity. Standard Guidelines / DeVita / Harrison, general reference. DRAFT, experimental.
